passage.text: This is my first trip abroad, and I'm in Japan with my family!
passage.reading: ðɪs ɪz maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈtrɪp əˈbrɔːd, ənd aɪm ɪn dʒəˈpæn wɪð maɪ ˈfæməli!

passage.text: Today we went to a big park in Tokyo to see the cherry blossoms.
passage.reading: təˈdeɪ wiː ˈwɛnt tə ə ˈbɪɡ ˈpɑːrk ɪn ˈtoʊkioʊ tə ˈsiː ðə ˈtʃɛri ˌblɑːsəmz.

passage.text: The trees were pink and white, and the park was very crowded.
passage.reading: ðə ˈtriːz wɜːr ˈpɪŋk ənd ˈwaɪt, ənd ðə ˈpɑːrk wʌz ˈvɛri ˈkraʊdɪd.

passage.text: I've never seen so many flowers!
passage.reading: aɪv ˈnɛvər ˈsiːn ˈsoʊ ˈmɛni ˈflaʊərz!

passage.text: In the afternoon, we visited an old shrine.
passage.reading: ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn, wiː ˈvɪzɪtɪd ən ˈoʊld ˈʃraɪn.

passage.text: It was quiet and peaceful, and I bought a small gift for Emma there.
passage.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈkwaɪət ənd ˈpiːsfəl, ənd aɪ ˈbɔːt ə ˈsmɔːl ˈɡɪft fər ˈɛmə ˈðɛr.

passage.text: Japanese shrines are different from Thai temples, but they are beautiful, too.
passage.reading: ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈʃraɪnz ər ˈdɪfərənt frəm ˈtaɪ ˈtɛmpəlz, bʌt ðeɪ ər ˈbjuːtəfəl, ˈtuː.

passage.text: Tomorrow we're going to take the bullet train to Kyoto.
passage.reading: təˈmɑːroʊ wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈteɪk ðə ˈbʊlɪt ˌtreɪn tə kiˈoʊtoʊ.

passage.text: It's very fast, so the journey only takes about two hours.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈfæst, soʊ ðə ˈdʒɜːrni ˈoʊnli ˈteɪks əˈbaʊt ˈtuː ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: There are vending machines on every street here, and Fah has bought a drink from almost every one!
passage.reading: ðɛr ər ˈvɛndɪŋ məˌʃiːnz ɑːn ˈɛvri ˈstriːt ˈhɪr, ənd ˈfɑː hæz ˈbɔːt ə ˈdrɪŋk frəm ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvri ˈwʌn!
